from pathlib import Path

code='''def transform(grid):
    # The rightmost object above the divider is stacked above the object below it.
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next(r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row))
    tops = [(r,c) for r in range(sep) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] not in (0,5)]
    bot = [(r,c) for r in range(sep+1,rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] not in (0,5)]
    color = grid[max(tops)[0]][max(tops)[1]]
    # identify rightmost top-colored component
    tc = max(grid[r][c] for r,c in tops) if False else None
    colors = sorted({grid[r][c] for r,c in tops}, key=lambda v:max(c for r,c in tops if grid[r][c]==v))
    chosen = colors[-1]
    shape = [(r,c) for r,c in tops if grid[r][c]==chosen]
    br0,bc0=min(r for r,c in bot),min(c for r,c in bot)
    tr0,tc0=min(r for r,c in shape),min(c for r,c in shape)
    out=[[0]*cols for _ in range(9)]
    for r,c in shape: out[r-tr0][bc0+c-tc0]=chosen
    for r,c in bot: out[3+r-min(x for x,y in bot)][bc0+c-min(y for x,y in bot)]=grid[r][c]
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
